cards.title: One unit page
cards.text: A hero in the camp and a card in the Book now open the same page, with pages side by side to swipe.
cards.why: Your layout, built: heroes get Main, Upgrades, Preview and Stats; enemies get Overview, Preview and Stats with Base, Elite and Major on top.
cards.details:
The camp's old Gear / Skills / About panel is gone; everything it did (wear a trinket, pack a potion, learn a node, recruit) works from this page, whether you came from the camp, the Book or a battle setup row.

For 'very busy and packed together': each page holds one thing, in two text sizes, with no boxes round things that aren't buttons, and nothing is said twice on a page.

The screens I think are still the busiest: a hero's Stats once it has runs (long, and it ends in the old damage-by-source list), a dungeon's page (three rows of look-alike portraits), and the Monsters grid (147 tiles).

Not done: a tile in the battle picker doesn't open the page (a tap there adds the unit; the row in your line-up does). The pause panel inside a run still has the old numbers row without icons.

parts.title: Hero: Main
parts.text: Equipment, potions, the trait, and where the hero is.

parts.title: Hero: Upgrades
parts.text: The skill web. One finger pans the web, so here a swipe turns the page only from the screen's edges or on the tabs.

parts.title: Hero: Preview
parts.text: The stage runs the full width, with the attack, abilities and trait as buttons under it and the tier below.

parts.title: Hero: Stats
parts.text: Every stat with an icon and a number: health, armour, speed, the weapon, each ability's cooldown, the trait's number, resistances, then all-run totals.

parts.title: Enemy pages
parts.text: Overview has times defeated, where it's found and how it fights. Base, Elite and Major switch on top. Stats are as in the game, with a stepper through every dungeon floor, opening on the first place you meet it.

parts.title: Stat icons: stand-ins
parts.text: The 28 stat icons are a plain stand-in set. Your pick from the icons deck replaces them in one place.

cards.title: The Book as grids
cards.text: Five grids to swipe between: heroes, monsters, trinkets, statuses, dungeons. No bottom strip.
cards.why: You asked for grids instead of the bottom bar, and a page each for heroes, trinkets, statuses and dungeons. Back returns to the grid where you left it.
cards.details: Potions sit under the trinkets on the Trinkets grid; there is no sixth tab. A dungeon's page shows its floors, who lives there, the mini-bosses and boss, your deepest floor and boss kills. The save keeps no runs, deaths or fastest clear by dungeon, so those aren't shown; say if you want them counted from now on.

parts.title: Monsters
parts.text: By dungeon, with what you haven't met as shadows.

parts.title: Trinkets and potions
parts.text: One grid, potions under the trinkets.

parts.title: Statuses
parts.text: Build-ups first, then what a burst leaves, then the good ones.

cards.title: Preview notes
cards.text: Locked abilities play, nothing is written on the stage, trait scenes show only what they need.
cards.why: Each part is one of your preview notes. Mark any that still doesn't show its effect.
cards.details:
51 tier steps change only a number (12% to 16%, 5 s to 7 s). On the stage they show only as longer or bigger; the words are in the caption under it.

Traits that are a small percentage stay subtle: Rhythm, Well Fed, Keen Edge and Barkskin show mostly as the gold ring and a small difference between two health bars.

parts.title: Locked still previews
parts.text: A locked ability plays as it is at tier I, with a lock on the stage's corner and on its button.

parts.title: No text on the stage
parts.text: Nothing is written on any stage; tier words are in the caption under it. I took the hit numbers off too: the next card asks about that.

parts.title: Trait scenes
parts.text: All 53 traits have their own scene. Attackers are targets holding a sword, bow, spear or hammer, not an Archer standing by. A gold ring pulses when the trait acts. A number-only trait is shown as two things side by side.

parts.title: Elites and majors
parts.text: No trinkets on elites or majors: off the stage, out of the words, out of the stats.

parts.title: The build-up meter
parts.text: It freaked out because it showed the raw value, which empties the instant it fills. Now it fills, holds full through the burst, then falls, at a fixed size.

parts.title: Frozen: both ways
parts.text: The stage plays it left alone and shattered in turn, with a switch to hold one. Asleep and Sleepy get the same: left alone, or woken.

cards.title: Dev controls, one place
cards.text: Settings has one Dev section: unlimited gold and points, the whole skill web, every unit in battle mode.
cards.why: You asked for all dev controls in one place. The switch on the battle picker is gone.

cards.title: Hit numbers in previews
cards.text: You said no text pop-ups in previews. Should the damage numbers go too?
cards.why: They're off for now, so a preview shows only the effect and the health bars. But they are how the game itself shows a harder hit, and tier steps that only raise a number are hard to see without them.

cards.title: Swiping over the skill web
cards.text: On Upgrades, one finger pans the web. How should you get to the next page from there?
cards.why: Dragging the web and swiping pages are the same gesture, so one of them has to give on this page.

options.label: Swipe from the edges or tap a tab
One finger swipes, two pan the web
